query: SELECT r.id AS "id!", r.tenant_id AS "tenant_id!", r.request_type::text AS "request_type!", GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - r.created_at))::int) AS "waiting_seconds!", r.escalation_level AS "escalation_level?", b.bed_number AS "bed_number?", w.name AS "ward_name?", a.department_id AS "department_id?", ack.supervisor_id AS "supervisor_id?" FROM bedside_nurse_requests r LEFT JOIN admissions a ON a.id = r.admission_id AND a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN beds b ON b.id = a.bed_id AND b.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN wards w ON w.id = a.ward_id AND w.tenant_id = r.tenant_id LEFT JOIN users ack ON ack.id = r.acknowledged_by LEFT JOIN tenant_settings esc ON esc.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND esc.category = 'clinical' AND esc.key = 'nurse_call_escalate_secs' WHERE r.completed_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - r.created_at))::int >= COALESCE((esc.value #>> '{}')::int, $1) ORDER BY r.created_at LIMIT 500
